copy.tagline: Know what your infill build will cost — before you commit.
copy.narrativeDisclaimer: Dollar figures are calculated deterministically from our cost model — not generated by AI.

landing.eyebrow: Calgary Custom Infill · Free Feasibility Estimates
landing.heroTitle: What will it really cost to build your home in Calgary?
landing.heroSub: A free range-based estimate for your Calgary infill project — land, build, and total investment — in under 2 minutes.
landing.howItWorksSub: No registration required. No phone calls. No salesperson involved.

steps.title: Enter your Calgary address
steps.body: We pull the City property record — lot size, zoning, and assessed value.

steps.title: Configure your scope
steps.body: Square footage, finish tier, garage, and basement. Approximate figures are fine.

steps.title: Unlock your full report
steps.body: A range-based estimate with an AI summary, risk factors, and a downloadable PDF.

search.label: Your Calgary address
search.emptyHint: Enter your Calgary address above to get started.
search.noResults: We couldn't find that address. Check the spelling or try a nearby address.
search.error: Address search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

wizard.scopeSqftHint: Approximate above-grade living area. Most Calgary infills land between 1,800 and 3,500 sq ft — a rough number is fine.
wizard.scopeTierHint: The level of finishes throughout the home. It shapes the estimate range — there are no prices on this page.

scopeTiers.name: Standard
scopeTiers.blurb: Durable, builder-grade finishes: quartz-look counters, LVP or carpet flooring, and standard lighting and plumbing packages.

scopeTiers.name: Premium
scopeTiers.blurb: A clear step up in every room: hardwood and tile, stone counters, upgraded cabinetry, and designer lighting and plumbing fixtures.

scopeTiers.name: Luxury
scopeTiers.blurb: Top shelf throughout: custom millwork, natural stone, premium appliances, spa-style bathrooms, and smart-home rough-ins.

wizard.detailsPreviewNote: The preview step arrives in the next build.

seo.scope: Set your build size and finish tier for a Calgary infill estimate — step 2 of 3.
seo.details: Configure square footage, finish tier, garage, and basement for your Calgary build estimate — step 3 of 3.
seo.privacy: How Feasly collects, uses, and protects your information when you generate a build estimate.
seo.terms: The terms that apply when you use Feasly to generate a build estimate.
seo.report: Your range-based Calgary infill build estimate: cost breakdown, tier scenarios, and next steps.

report.heading: Your build estimate
report.subPreGate: Your preview is ready — unlock it to see the full numbers.
report.subPostGate: Full range-based estimate for your Calgary infill build.
report.lockedNote: Locked — unlock to reveal the figures.
report.breakdownLocked: The itemized breakdown unlocks with your full report.
report.tierTitle: What if you change the finish tier?
report.tierHint: Switch tiers to re-run the estimate. The range moves because the finishes change — that is where the variance lives.
report.tierLockedNote: Unlock your report to explore finish tiers.
report.adjustHint: Change the living area and re-run the estimate with the new size.
report.adjustLockedNote: Unlock your report to adjust the size.
report.narrativeComingSoon: An AI-written summary of your estimate, the key risks, and what to watch for is coming soon.

steps.title: Talk to a builder
steps.body: Share this report with 2–3 Calgary infill builders and ask for detailed quotes against the same scope.

steps.title: Confirm financing
steps.body: Take the total range to your mortgage broker to confirm what you can carry before you commit to land or a builder.

steps.title: Verify zoning and permits
steps.body: Confirm the lot zoning and permit requirements with the City of Calgary before you buy or demolish.
